_note: Per-repo metadata per RFC 0004, which lives in the platform-atlas repo at docs/rfc/0004-cross-repo-metadata-standards.md. Seed values; the field set is formalized by the forthcoming repo-manifest.json schema ADR, so fields may change. No scanner consumes this file yet.
purpose: Helm chart library for Tithely Kubernetes deployments (generic-service, argocd-app). Publishes packaged charts to the tithely.github.io/helm-charts Helm repo via chart-releaser; consumed by devops-cicd (Flux) and devops-argocd (ArgoCD).
delivery: Helm chart library. Not a deployed runtime service; on merge to main, chart-releaser packages each chart and publishes it to the GitHub Pages Helm repo, tagged <chart>-<version>. Consumers pin a specific version.
